title: Career Roadmap · Sheet Metal Worker
summary: A Sheet Metal Worker measures, cuts, bends, forms and assembles metal sheets to manufacture ducts, panels, enclosures, vehicle parts and industrial components.

blocks.text: Primary pathway

items: ITI Sheet Metal Worker / relevant fabrication trade

blocks.text: Core work
Engineering drawings • Measuring and marking • Cutting • Bending • Forming • Joining • Assembly • Quality checks.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science; check the selected trade’s official entry criteria.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful but not always required for an ITI route.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Metal fabrication, workshop practice, HVAC ducting, vehicle body panels and industrial enclosures.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Measurement, geometry, drawing interpretation, safe tool handling and basic computer use.

rows.text: Broader fabrication, production and design roles

items: Fabrication, production or CAD-related roles, subject to employer requirements

blocks.text: Use the official NCVT MIS ITI search to verify institutes and trade availability. DGT lists Sheet Metal Worker as a one-year, 1,200-hour ITI trade, with Class 10 as the listed entry qualification.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workshop safety, engineering drawings, measuring, marking and hand tools.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Fabrication
blocks.text: Cutting, bending, folding, forming, drilling, riveting and joining.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Sheet-metal layout, precision assembly, welding, CNC cutting and quality inspection.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Practical portfolio, workshop experience, apprenticeship applications and trade assessments.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Fabricate a sheet-metal box • Make an L-bracket • Build a small ventilation duct • Assemble a panel enclosure to drawing specifications.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Railway workshops, defence production units and public-sector engineering facilities.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: HVAC contractors, automotive component makers, electrical enclosure manufacturers, shipyards and industrial fabrication companies.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Duct fabrication • Sheet cutting and bending • Vehicle panels • Industrial cabinets and enclosures.
Search Apprenticeship India for openings. Selection and stipend depend on the employer and current notification.

blocks.label: Design route
blocks.text: ITI + CAD skills → Sheet-metal CAD technician, subject to employer requirements.

blocks.label: Further education
blocks.text: Eligible Mechanical Engineering diploma → production, fabrication or design-related roles.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Institutions to investigate
blocks.text: Government ITIs, NSTIs, state polytechnics, recognized skill centres and employer training facilities. Confirm specific course availability before applying.

items.text: CNC Laser / Plasma Cutting Operator, with suitable training

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: HVAC, automotive, railways, aerospace, shipbuilding, electrical equipment, construction and industrial manufacturing.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Drawing interpretation, layout development, measurement, cutting, bending, forming, riveting, welding basics and dimensional inspection.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Shears, press brakes, rollers, drills, measuring tools, CNC laser/plasma systems and CAD software.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized Sheet Metal Worker trade certificate.
Welding qualifications for relevant joining tasks.
CAD/CAM or CNC training from a recognized provider.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Training options
blocks.text: Recognized vocational colleges and technical institutes offering sheet-metal fabrication, metalworking, welding or manufacturing technology.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Prior education or trade experience, language proficiency where required, practical assessments and study-visa documentation. Recognition of an Indian qualification varies by provider and country.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Sheet Metal Worker, Fabricator, Duct Installer / Fabricator, Metal Fabrication Technician and CNC Cutting Operator.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: HVAC, construction, transport, aerospace, shipbuilding and manufacturing.

items: local skills assessment or additional training if required
